blocks.text: In the Pantanal, you can spot jaguars from a boat or while flying over the wetlands. In Bonito, the journey takes you underground to Abismo Anhumas, where a lake lies beneath spectacular stalactite formations. You will also follow a canopy course through the treetops and discover the underwater world of the Rio Sucuri. In southern Brazil, enjoy visits to wineries, a spa hotel amid vineyards, a helicopter flight over the canyons of Cambará do Sul and a picnic at the canyon’s edge. In Rio de Janeiro, the itinerary includes a caipirinha-making masterclass.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The verified English Word 2027 describes all these experiences across separate day-by-day paragraphs, but contains no exact equivalent of this consolidated Russian overview.
